serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Come on, we don’t have much time!
Bot: For what? Where are we going?
You: Today I’m taking you to an art gallery.
Bot: Ok, but why are we in such a hurry?
You: We need to get on a bus! The next one is driving off pretty soon!
Bot: Bus? Isn't the art gallery pretty close?
You: Yes, but we are going to a different one.
Bot: Oh.{{wi}} Why? 
You: We already saw what was in that one, right? It could be months before there will be a new exhibition there.
Bot: That makes sense.
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: But you won’t meet your friend there. Aren’t you sad?
You: N-No, I don’t think so. We are not that close.
You: Here’s our bus! We gotta get in before its doors close down!
